statute_note: Principal source: the LankaLaw consolidated HTML (chain header 'Law Nos, 1 of 1972 39 of 1975 Act Nos, 14 of 1981 39 of 1981 14 of 1986 18 of 1986'), parsed by build_canonical_statutes.py into an 83-section tree with 8 parts, 14 definitions and 4 source footnotes. Other sources inspected: the registry's compendium PDF (1980 revised edition volume 3, Cap. 297 at PDF pages 401 to 423, chain 'Laws Nos. 1 of 1972, 39 of 1975'), used as the verification source; the section index (83, matching); every held amending file, whose title pages were read from the scans. Consolidation cutoff: Act No. 18 of 1986. Review performed: every section number in the tree other than the five inserted after 1975 (27A, 27B, 28A, 42LL, 59A) was located as a section start in the compendium pages; marginal notes read for sections 26 and 43 and the HTML headings corrected to them with the raw reading kept; the head date compared; validate_finalized_trees.py reports 0 errors and every remaining warning is documented in the trees. Not read word for word throughout. Amendment coverage: 5 instruments in the chain, all held as HTML and parsed, four also held as Government Printer scans with no text layer; all already incorporated, nothing applied. `amends` filled from each long title; 18 of 1986 names Act 39 of 1981 rather than the Law. Two repealing instruments named only in footnotes (42 of 1973, 19 of 1978) are not held. Structural weaknesses: the 39 of 1975 amending tree runs section 2 and inserted 42A into section 1 and loses 42D as a node; the HTML heading of 28A reads 'viewer' where 'waiver' is suspected but unprovable from held sources; the two held editions disagree on the head date (22nd versus 26th August 1972). Missing sources: the Government Printer text of Law No. 1 of 1972 and of Law No. 39 of 1975; a post-1986 consolidated edition. Unresolved questions: the head date; whether anything after 18 of 1986 amends the Law. Status: needs_structural_review, because two held copies disagree on the head date and one amending tree is structurally defective. Lawyer verification: unverified.
